# awscc_sagemaker_workforce (Resource)

Resource Type definition for AWS::SageMaker::Workforce. Use to create a private workforce that you can use to label your training data using Amazon SageMaker Ground Truth.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `workforce_name` (String) The name of the private workforce.

### Optional

- `cognito_config` (Attributes) The configuration of an Amazon Cognito workforce. A single Cognito workforce is created using and corresponds to a single Amazon Cognito user pool. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--cognito_config))
- `ip_address_type` (String) The IP address type for the workforce. IPv4 only or dualstack (IPv4 and IPv6).
- `oidc_config` (Attributes) The configuration of an OIDC Identity Provider (IdP) private workforce. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--oidc_config))
- `source_ip_config` (Attributes) A list of IP address ranges used to access your training data. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--source_ip_config))
- `tags` (Attributes List) An array of key-value pairs. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--tags))
- `workforce_vpc_config` (Attributes) The VPC configuration for the workforce. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--workforce_vpc_config))

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Uniquely identifies the resource.
- `sub_domain` (String) The subdomain for your OIDC Identity Provider.
- `workforce_arn` (String) The Amazon Resource Name (ARN) of the private workforce.

<a id="nestedatt--cognito_config"></a>
### Nested Schema for `cognito_config`

Optional:

- `client_id` (String) The client ID for your Amazon Cognito user pool.
- `user_pool` (String) The ID for your Amazon Cognito user pool.


<a id="nestedatt--oidc_config"></a>
### Nested Schema for `oidc_config`

Optional:

- `authentication_request_extra_params` (Map of String) A string to string map of identifiers specific to the custom identity provider (IdP) being used.
- `authorization_endpoint` (String) The OIDC IdP authorization endpoint used to configure your private workforce.
- `client_id` (String) The OIDC IdP client ID used to configure your private workforce.
- `client_secret` (String) The OIDC IdP client secret used to configure your private workforce.
- `issuer` (String) The OIDC IdP issuer used to configure your private workforce.
- `jwks_uri` (String) The OIDC IdP JSON Web Key Set (Jwks) URI used to configure your private workforce.
- `logout_endpoint` (String) The OIDC IdP logout endpoint used to configure your private workforce.
- `scope` (String) An array of string identifiers used to refer to the specific pieces of user data or claims that the client application wants to access.
- `token_endpoint` (String) The OIDC IdP token endpoint used to configure your private workforce.
- `user_info_endpoint` (String) The OIDC IdP user info endpoint used to configure your private workforce.


<a id="nestedatt--source_ip_config"></a>
### Nested Schema for `source_ip_config`

Optional:

- `cidrs` (List of String) A list of one to ten Classless Inter-Domain Routing (CIDR) values.

- `value` (String) The tag value.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

In Terraform v1.12.0 and later, the [`import` block](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/import) can be used with the `identity` attribute, for example:

```terraform
import {
  to = awscc_sagemaker_workforce.example
  identity = {
    workforce_arn = "workforce_arn"
  }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
### Identity Schema

#### Required

- `workforce_arn` (String) The Amazon Resource Name (ARN) of the private workforce

#### Optional

- `account_id` (String) AWS Account where this resource is managed
- `region` (String) Region where this resource is managed

In Terraform v1.5.0 and later, the [`import` block](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/import) can be used with the `id` attribute, for example:

```terraform
import {
  to = awscc_sagemaker_workforce.example
  id = "workforce_arn"
}
```

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
$ terraform import awscc_sagemaker_workforce.example "workforce_arn"
```
